addr: Shopping Complex Unit-30, 2, 10th Main Rd, near Canara Bank, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: An average place for all the essentials clothing, accessories, pooja items, footwear, home decor, street foods as well. It's good if you want to purchase many things at one place. Price is normal not low even the atmosphere should be improved.
Quite crowded area, Ladies love shopping here as the c lot of items of their liking and use.
Better than Jayanagar. The vibe is good. Good food. Better shopping experience.
